tools.name: stripe_api_search
tools.description: Search for Stripe API methods by keyword.

tools.name: stripe_api_details
tools.description: Get detailed parameter information for a specific Stripe API method.

tools.name: stripe_api_read
tools.description: Read data with any Stripe API GET method (customers, charges, invoices, subscriptions, payment intents, balance and more).

tools.name: stripe_api_write
tools.description: Write data with any Stripe API POST, PATCH, PUT or DELETE method, such as creating customers, invoices, refunds, products and prices. Some actions need human confirmation.

tools.name: stripe_analytics
tools.description: Preview: query metrics, analyse subscriptions and billing and run financial reports; with Sigma, build SQL queries from natural language.

tools.name: get_balance_summary
tools.description: Displays an interactive balance summary across the Stripe balance and Treasury accounts.

tools.name: search_stripe_documentation
tools.description: Search the Stripe documentation for the given question and language.

tools.name: stripe_implementation_planner
tools.description: Guides the user through Stripe products to accept payments, sell products online, set up billing or build any Stripe integration.
